title: SOC2 evidence scratchpad - daily
content:
2025-03-03 daily scratchpad - quick brain dump and todo for SOC2 evidence collection

Top priorities for today:
- Finalize evidence folder structure for CC6 and CC7 (access control + change management).
- Collect screenshots: Okta application assignment for service accounts, IAM role binding list (GCP).
- Vendor reviews: follow up with LogRetention Inc. on data retention policy and contract scoping. Need SLA excerpt and DPA.
- Evidence owner updates: assign missing items from spreadsheet (see JIRA-SOC2-87).

Quick checklist (state = todo/in-progress/done):
- [in-progress] access-control matrix CSV (owner: Julia) -> export from internal sheet, scrub PII, upload to evidence drive
- [todo] vendor DPA for LogRetention Inc. (owner: Priya) -> email sent 2025-03-01, follow up if no reply by 2025-03-06
- [todo] KMS key rotation proof (owner: Noah) -> need screenshots of rotation schedule and audit logs
- [todo] change-management approvals for infra changes (owner: infra-team) -> link to PRs in github.com/redwood-inference/infra#243
- [in-progress] onboarding checklist for new hires (security training completion) -> pull training completion CSV from LMS

Notes / talking points for 10:30 sync with Priya + Noah:
- Review outstanding CC6 items and map to evidence artifacts (screenshot, policy, ticket)
- Decide canonical naming for evidence files (prefix: CC#_artifact_type_date_owner)
- Discuss temporary workaround for vendor missing DPA: use business memo + escalation to legal

Vendor review quick notes:
- LogRetention Inc.: CAI-123 contract. Concern: default retention 90 days, need 365 or DPA clause. Ask legal for addendum template.
- MonitoringCo: already have SOC2 Type II report; verify cover period includes last 12 months and relevant controls map
- AuthZLib (open-source dependency): record SCA result and decision if vendor or OSS policy applies

Evidence traceability matrix (very rough):
- CC6 (Access Controls): evidence types = policy doc (confluence), system screenshots (Okta/GCP), tickets (JIRA-SOC2-87), monthly review logs (sheets)
- CC7 (Change Management): evidence types = PR + approval comments (github), deployment runbooks (docs), rollback test notes (sre-runbook)

Open questions / blockers:
- Do we accept vendor SOC report with missing subservice auditor scope? (Ask Legal)
- How to capture ephemeral infra changes tied to feature flags? (Work with infra to record flag audits)
- Any objections to using redwood-internal-confluence as canonical policy store? I think fine but need cross-links in evidence zip

Micro-todos (short):
- Upload access matrix to evidence folder (today)
- Add link to DPA request email thread in confluence page (today)
- Create JIRA ticket for KMS rotation evidence if not exists (JIRA-SOC2-112?)
- Draft memo for temporary vendor mitigation (if DPA delayed)

References / links to add later:
- Confluence page: confluence:security/soc2-evidence (canonical)
- JIRA epic: JIRA-SOC2-87 (evidence collection epic)
- GitHub infra PRs: github.com/redwood-inference/infra#243 (change mgmt examples)

Random notes to self:
- Keep filenames short and searchable, no spaces. Example: CC6_okta_screenshot_2025-03-03_jramirez.png
- Capture timestamps in UTC for logs
- If Legal provides a DPA template, attach to confluence and link in evidence manifest

End of scratchpad for 2025-03-03.
